# partiteai_access_point_client_secret (Resource)

A secret an access point client signs in with. A client can have several, so a secret can be replaced without changing the client ID: add the new one, move callers to it, then remove the old one. `create_before_destroy` does this in one apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_point_client_id` (String) ID of the client the secret signs in as. Changing it replaces the secret.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the secret stops working. Left out, it doesn't expire. Changing it replaces the secret.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `last_used_at` (String) When the secret last signed in. A secret that stopped being used is safe to remove.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret. It is readable only when it is made, so an imported secret has none.
